name: AEGIS Conservation-Qualified Statistical Gödel Machine

classical_godel_machine.role: Formal proof-search-driven self-rewrite with a global-optimality result under the formalized utility/axiom setting.

statistical_godel_machine_2025.title: SGM: A Statistical Godel Machine for Risk-Controlled Recursive Self-Modification
statistical_godel_machine_2025.role: Existing statistical self-modification gate using confidence tests/e-values and cumulative risk budgeting.

aegis_candidate_differentiator: trusted epistemic-conservation receipt required before benefit evaluation
MHP-style semantic claim partition and derivation accounting
non-amplifying authority meet across verified transitions
protected authority/trust surfaces remain outside self-write authority
operator approval remains a separate transition

representation_principle.canonical_encoding: All machine-observed artifacts are reduced to canonical bytes/digests plus a semantic type.
representation_principle.pattern_space: Statistical and structural relations may be proposed over typed representations.
representation_principle.proof_space: Formal claims require kernel-verifiable proof receipts; statistical claims require bounded sequential evidence.
representation_principle.semantic_non_equivalence: Equal or correlated numerical representations do not imply equal meaning, causality, or physical truth.

epistemic_rule: Pattern detection may generate hypotheses. Only typed evidence may change claim state. No evidence class may silently coerce into another.
